question: My daughter said she needs help with research for a paper and mentioned a librarian named Reppert. Is she a librarian, and how can my daughter reach her?
answer:
Linda Reppert’s directory title is Unit Secretary in Library Faculty & Staff, not librarian. [1][2] The directory lists her office as LC-418 and phone as (201) 684-7569. It also links to a contact form: https://www.ramapo.edu/library/contact-form-lre/. [1][2] The directory/profile do not publish her email address. [1]

For research help, the Library offers research appointments at https://libcal.ramapo.edu/appointments and in-person help. [6][8][9] Students can also come during Research Help Desk hours or check the hours for virtual help; if chat is offline, email refdesk@ramapo.edu. [7] Fall Semester (Aug. 26 – Dec. 15, 2026) hours are Mon-Thu: 9:00am – 9:00pm; Fri: 9:00am – 4:00pm; Sat & Sun: 3:00pm – 6:00pm. If Research Help is offline, email refdesk@ramapo.edu and staff will get back as soon as possible. [10]

Sources: [1](https://www.ramapo.edu/library/staff/) [2](https://www.ramapo.edu/library/staff-directory/) [6](https://www.ramapo.edu/library/research-help-services/) [7](https://www.ramapo.edu/library/library-news/) [8](https://www.ramapo.edu/library/ask-a-librarian-sidebar/) [9](https://www.ramapo.edu/library/ask-a-librarian-sidebar/) [10](https://www.ramapo.edu/library/research-help-services/)

question: Can you please tell me if Dr. Chan is a good professor? My daughter is struggling in his class and I am worried.
answer:
I can’t assess whether Dr. Chan is a good professor; that’s an opinion not covered by the pages. The directory lists Benny Chan as Dean of SNH / Professor of Chemistry in the School of Science, Nursing, and Health [3].

The ENHANCE parent guidance applies to parents and guardians of ENHANCE students: “faculty will not respond to parents.” It advises encouraging your daughter to speak to her professor, send an email, or speak to ENHANCE for advice [4]. Students are encouraged to contact professors about grading concerns, and parents are recommended to maintain open communication with their students about academic progress [5]. Ask whether she is attending class, keeping up with assignments, balancing activities, and satisfied with her grades [9].

For general support, Counseling Services says you can call (201) 684-7522 with questions or to consult with a psychological counselor [8].

Sources: [3](https://www.ramapo.edu/snh/faculty/benny-chan/) [4](https://www.ramapo.edu/enhance/information-for-parents-and-guardians/) [5](https://www.ramapo.edu/enhance/information-for-parents-and-guardians/) [8](https://www.ramapo.edu/counseling/parent-resources/) [9](https://www.ramapo.edu/counseling/parent-resources/)
